channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Baron Davis | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Baron Davis from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Andrei Kirilenko, Baron Davis
item.description:
Connor Letourneau:Stephen Curry on his big yell late in the game:

“It's a different vibe when you know the game has consequences and means something. ... Shout out to Baron Davis. I definitely channeled my Kirilenko moment.”

Stephen Curry on Andrei Kirilenko, Baron Davis, May 16, 2021. Source: Twitter @Con_Chron.

item.title: Matt Barnes on Stephen Jackson, Baron Davis
item.description:
“Myself, Baron Davis, Jack (Stephen Jackson) -- we're getting the crew back together. We've assembled a solid team behind to help produce and direct it.”

Matt Barnes on Stephen Jackson, Baron Davis, Jun 19, 2020. Source: NBC Sports.

item.title: Stephen Jackson on Don Nelson, Baron Davis
item.description:
“We're in Utah and the drug test people are around, you know, to get our last drug test, so we can smoke, right? And Don Nelson, we talked about weed all the time, he was cool with talking about weed. We got our last test in Utah, right? So me and Baron [Davis] are coming out the locker room just screaming, excited, right, with our last pink slip saying we could smoke for the rest of the season. And Don Nelson hauls ass down there giving us high-fives like, 'Yeah, we can smoke now!' It was cool, the fact that he knows what's going on off the court with his players, which was great, man. We enjoyed it. And that's why we were a great team.”

Stephen Jackson on Don Nelson, Baron Davis, Jan 30, 2017. Source: CBSSports.com.

item.title: Blake Griffin on Baron Davis
item.description:
“I wanted to have Baron Davis and some of my teammates roll out in a convertible, and then just toss it straight up and jump over the whole thing, instead of just the hood.”

Blake Griffin on Baron Davis, Jun 6, 2016. Source: Sports Illustrated.

item.title: Byron Scott on Baron Davis
item.description:
Sam Amico:Byron Scott added,

“I hope (Davis) looks at this as an opportunity to change everyone's mind about type of guy and type of player he is.”

Byron Scott on Baron Davis, Feb 24, 2011. Source: Twitter.
